narrative: I opened a credit card with promotional 0% APR for 18 months, but the bank charged me interest on my second statement. Customer service refused to reverse the finance charges.

My annual credit report from Equifax lists an auto loan from a bank I have never dealt with. I submitted written disputes with proof of identity theft, but the bureau verified the fraudulent trade line without investigation.

A debt collector called my workplace five times today demanding immediate payment for a medical bill from seven years ago that was already settled. They threatened wage garnishment and contacted my supervisor.

We submitted our complete mortgage refinancing application and locked our interest rate at 5.5%. The mortgage servicer delayed processing past the 60-day lock period and is now demanding higher points to close.

I attempted an ATM withdrawal of $400 at a branch machine. The machine dispensed no cash and displayed an error, but my checking account balance was deducted immediately. The branch told me to wait 30 days for a provisional credit.
Unauthorized foreign transaction fees were added to my debit card statement while traveling domestically. The merchant confirmed they processed in USD.
A collection agency sent letters demanding repayment for a credit card debt discharged in bankruptcy court three years ago. They continue to report an active delinquent balance to Experian.

The lender miscalculated my property tax escrow shortage and increased my monthly mortgage payment by over $600. When I provided tax receipts showing no shortage, they refused to adjust the escrow analysis.
Public record bankruptcy remark remains on my TransUnion file even though the maximum statutory reporting period has expired. TransUnion ignored my certified dispute letter.
The bank placed an unexpected hold on a cashier's check deposited into my business checking account, causing several payroll checks to bounce and incurring multiple overdraft fees.
